title: Bana mayor wounded in Pattani ambush
summary: The mayor of Bana town municipality in Pattani was seriously wounded when unidentified gunmen shot him outside his home in Muang district on Thursday night.

title: CCTV cameras targeted in coordinated Narathiwat attacks
summary: Suspected insurgents staged coordinated early-morning attacks targeting CCTV cameras, burning tyres and setting off explosions in Narathiwat’s Chanae and Waeng districts on Friday, with no casualties ...
